assetId.title: Product Record Id
assetId.description: Product the claim is filed against. Use only the id returned by the product lookup.

contentDocumentId.title: Photo File Id
contentDocumentId.description: Id of the photo the customer sent, when it is already stored

defectCategory.title: Defect Category
defectCategory.description: Exactly one of Not Working, Physical Damage, Missing Parts, Wrong Item, Other

description.title: Description
description.description: What the customer described, in their own words. At least 15 characters.

serialNumber.title: Serial Number
serialNumber.description: Serial of the product the customer chose, when they own more than one covered product
